rows.whyItCannotBeResolvedHere: Every Alabama family in this backlog binds two sources. C-10-CRIMINAL (527d4cfdde5bea564a8729e6425f1042627b03435ec634509fe32fdb80a5c6f8) is mounted. defectLocatedForTheNextContainer.howThisWasLocated: Without CR-65 the packet cannot be built, but the shared build host scripts/build-census-v1-al-diversion-set.mjs can be read and the mounted C-10-CRIMINAL binary can be censused. knownValue() was executed against C-10-CRIMINAL's own 78 text fields with the committed canonical fixture, reproducing the mis-writes the verifiers reported from first principles.

KNOWN_PREFILLS.defect: participant.full_legal_name is written into C-10-CRIMINAL page 1 field 'Spouses Full Name if married'
KNOWN_PREFILLS.cause: knownValue()'s /full name|printed name of petitioner|print or type name/ branch matches 'Spouses Full Name if married'. It fires before any field-specific check.
KNOWN_PREFILLS.why it matters: On a signed affidavit of substantial hardship it asserts the participant is married to themselves. A false statement, not a cosmetic one.

KNOWN_PREFILLS.defect: participant.phone is written into C-10-CRIMINAL page 1 field 'Employers Telephone Number'
KNOWN_PREFILLS.cause: knownValue()'s /telephone number|telephone number cell/ branch matches 'Employers Telephone Number'; its exclusion list is only /attorney|server/.
KNOWN_PREFILLS.why it matters: It asserts the participant's own number as their employer's, on the same sworn affidavit.

KNOWN_PREFILLS.defect: 'Circuit' is written into C-10-CRIMINAL page 1 field 'COURT OF', whose printed sublabel asks for the county or municipality
KNOWN_PREFILLS.cause: knownValue()'s C-10 branch returns ['Circuit','matter.court_type'] for BOTH 'IN THE' and 'COURT OF'. Only 'IN THE' takes the court type.

KNOWN_PREFILLS.defect: the filing county is written after 'MUNICIPALITY OF' on a circuit-court route
KNOWN_PREFILLS.cause: knownValue()'s /municipality of/ C-10 branch, unconditional on the route.

KNOWN_PREFILLS.defect: CR-65 page 5 receives generic instruction strings instead of held case facts - 'The charge shown on the certified case record', 'Agency shown on the certified arrest record', 'See the selected statutory route and attached certified records'
KNOWN_PREFILLS.cause: the FIXTURES object in the same host carries those sentences as the values of fixture.charge, fixture.arrestAgency and fixture.grounds. Not verifiable here; CR-65 is not mounted.

PROTECTED_FIELDS.defect: the participant phone lands on CR-65 page 6's attorney Telephone Number line
PROTECTED_FIELDS.cause: ORDERING. fillDocument() consults knownValue() FIRST and only reaches attorneyField() in a later branch. attorneyField() names /telephone number_2/ explicitly, but knownValue()'s /telephone number/ branch has already returned the phone and its exclusion list (/attorney|server/) does not contain 'telephone number_2'. Located by reading scripts/build-census-v1-al-diversion-set.mjs lines 86, 108-110 and 140-147.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.defect: 47 of the 63 declared items are internal field names rather than captions a participant can find on the paper - 'undefined' through 'undefined_32', 'Text1', 'Text2'
REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.cause: fillDocument() sets effectiveLabel to `Complete ${name} on ${documentId} page ${page}` for every unmatched field, and to `name` for every write. There is no printed-label harvest on this host at all.
REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.measured: C-10-CRIMINAL alone carries 37 text fields literally named 'undefined' or 'undefined_N' and 2 named 'TextN', out of 78. Counted from the mounted binary. The rest of the 47 are on CR-65.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.defect: C-10-CRIMINAL's STATE OF ALABAMA and MUNICIPALITY OF caption checkboxes are both left unmarked while the municipality line is filled with the filing county, on a route whose court is known to be the circuit court
ROUTE_OPTIONS.cause: the checkbox branch of fillDocument() marks a checkbox only when documentId is CR-65 and the name is in config.selected. No C-10-CRIMINAL checkbox is ever selected on any Alabama family.

defectLocatedForTheNextContainer.notLocatable: CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP on al-felony-dwop-set (the boundary name cut to 'Alexandria Catherine Montgomery-Wash' in CR-65 page 6's Printed Name of Petitioner), REPEATING_ROWS, SERVICE and SELF_HELP_STOP all turn on CR-65's own widgets or on the instruction text, and could not be measured without the binary. Their verifier findings stand as the record.
defectLocatedForTheNextContainer.oneRepairNoteForWhoeverGetsTheBytes: safeSet() calls field.setFontSize(8) and TRUNCATES with value.slice(0, maxLength) whenever the widget declares /MaxLen. That is where al-felony-dwop-set's clipped boundary name comes from, and a silent slice on a sworn petition is a defect of the same class as the mis-writes above: it delivers a name that is not the participant's. It should refuse rather than truncate.

rows.blocker: ROW STOP - not repairable without re-deriving this family's field classification

whatWasMeasuredHere.limbA: All 16 fields vf06 named are present and still carry requiredBeforeFiling: true in production-field-map.json: orderHearYr, hearDay, hearTime, hearTimeM, sigHearJdg, orderFinalDay, MuniCrts, probDivCntys, sigFinalJdg, CoverLtrDDt, CoverLtrEDt, CoverLtrEHearDt, CoverLtrEHearTime, expungDocketNum, sigNoticeDt, CoverLtrGDt. Their printed context was read out of the pinned CN-10557 binary at each widget's own rectangle and confirms the finding for fourteen of them: the four hearing date/time blanks and sigHearJdg sit on the ORDER FOR HEARING at page 27 ('IT IS ORDERED this ___ day of ___, ___' and 'is set for the ___ day of ___, at ___ o'clock ___.m.' and 'Judge, Superior Court of New Jersey'); orderFinalDay is the final order's own date line at page 30; sigFinalJdg is the judge's signature at page 33; expungDocketNum sits beside 'Appearing Pro Se  Docket Number:' at page 40, which the clerk assigns at filing; and the four cover-letter dates and the two cover-letter hearing date/time blanks are later acts.
whatWasMeasuredHere.whyTheLastTwoAreNotClearCut: MuniCrts ('The administrator(s) of the ___ Municipal Court(s),' page 27) and probDivCntys ('The ___ County(ies) Probation Division', page 27) are recipient lists on a PROPOSED order, and in the New Jersey kit the petitioner drafts the proposed order and its recipient list. AdminMuniCts, the same blank on the final order at page 31, is NOT in vf06's list, which makes the boundary between the two inconsistent on its face. Deciding it is a classification design decision about who owns a blank on a proposed order, not a repair to a named defect.
whatWasMeasuredHere.limbB: The label defect is wider than the fourteen vf06 counted. Of the 69 fields tagged requiredBeforeFiling, 11 display a label that is exactly the internal field name (CoverLtrDDt, CoverLtrEDt, IdbAddrStr, MuniCrtsAddrStr, ProbAddrStr, cnt, contOffense2, jdgmntDocket1 through jdgmntDocket4, sigFinalJdg, sigHearJdg, sigNoticeDt) and a further 19 display a truncated fragment of a printed line - '(statu', '(statute', '. I was arre', 'a', ',', 'an Order of', 'at', 'Original', 'The', 'Kit up', 'offense(s))', 'County Probatio' and others. The cause is a caption harvester that falls back to field.name and otherwise takes whatever text sits nearest the widget.

rows.whyThisIsStoppedRatherThanHalfRepaired: Repairing this obligation means re-deciding the ownership of sixteen blanks on a court's own forms, two of them against the New Jersey kit's own practice, and then authoring roughly thirty participant-facing captions for a forty-page kit. That is re-deriving this family's field classification, not repairing a named defect, and it is participant-facing legal copy on a document that is signed under oath. A partial pass would leave the obligation failing anyway. Stopped with the measurement above so the lane that takes it does not start from nothing.
rows.whatWouldUnblockIt: A grant that covers re-deriving this family's blank classification, and a decision on who owns a recipient list on a proposed order in the New Jersey kit. The five NJ families share scripts/build-census-v1-nj_arrest_no_conviction-set.mjs and the same CN-10557 kit, so the same defect is very likely on all five and the classification should be decided once.

countersProvenance.measuredHow: One run of `node scripts/rcap-packet-completeness/verify-packet-completeness.mjs --family <id>` per family, at the commit above, after this worktree was reset to the Captain tip that already carries this cohort's eight integrated repairs. Not copied from the notes taken at the original base 46caf9354c58c8ebce4004354fef5b237f391d3f: the repairs have since been rebased onto other lanes' changes and a stale number would be a claim rather than a measurement.
countersProvenance.result: All eight repaired families read PASS_COMPLETE with all nine counters at zero. None has regressed.
countersProvenance.whatCountersAfterDoesAndDoesNotShow: countersAfter is supplied because the integration gate requires it. It is not the evidence that any repair worked. Every one of these families read PASS_COMPLETE with nine zero counters BEFORE its repair as well: no counter can see a value the source authored, a clipped appearance inside its own box, a component order that contradicts the manifest, a second obsolete petition bound into a packet, or a filing destination naming the wrong court. Each row's `instrument` field names what actually measured its defect, and every one of those was re-run at this commit before this file was written.

twoRowShapesInThisFile: A row carrying repairedByThisLane: true is a family this cohort actually repaired, and its countersAfter was measured at the commit named in countersProvenance. A row carrying repairedByThisLane: false is a family this cohort deliberately changed nothing on, because its assigned defect was already absent when measured; those rows establish that a standing verdict is stale and they are not offered as repairs. Neither shape is a verdict, and every family here must still be verified by a lane that neither built nor repaired it.
